command:
set +e
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
cd /tmp
grep -E ' (pf01255\.25_seed\.fa|real\.sh)$' pins.sha256 > pins.sel
[ "$(wc -l < pins.sel)" -eq 2 ] && sha256sum -c pins.sel || { echo "FAIL: a staged input does not match its pin"; exit 1; }
mkdir -p out
iqtree3 -s pf01255.25_seed.fa -m MF -mset LG,WAG,JTT,Q.pfam -T 8 --seed 12345 --prefix mf -redo > out/mf.stdout 2>&1
echo "exit $?"
cp mf.log mf.iqtree mf.model.gz out/
